drift_model: Drift is evaluated by whether share-required changes are parked without D3 classification, not by commit-count size.

current_gate_status.d3: manual receipt required before any cross-line promotion

long_lived_branches.name: main
long_lived_branches.target: Owner-scheduled reconciliation point for web and dev focus lines.
long_lived_branches.expected_drift: May lag both focus lines until the operator schedules reconciliation.
long_lived_branches.drift_criterion: Unexpected only when a change required by both focus lines is left without a D3 receipt or explicit defer note.

long_lived_branches.name: web
long_lived_branches.target: Web product mainline and Web release source.
allowed_changes: shared UI/source changes with D3 classification when Desktop-impacting
workflow and governance docs for the web line
downstream: desktop-next via D3 when sharing is required
long_lived_branches.expected_drift: Expected to carry web-only commits that dev does not need.
long_lived_branches.drift_criterion: Unexpected only when a shared change needs Desktop impact review but has no D3 W0-W4 classification.

long_lived_branches.name: desktop-next
long_lived_branches.target: Web to Desktop integration branch and next-cycle App delta staging.
forbidden_changes: plugin platform churn unrelated to the current integration
upstream: desktop-plugin-next when plugin platform is READY
downstream: dev after integration cycle is green
long_lived_branches.expected_drift: Expected to differ from both web and dev during an active integration cycle.
long_lived_branches.drift_criterion: Unexpected only when an integration delta stays here without verification status or promotion/defer note.

long_lived_branches.name: desktop-plugin-next
long_lived_branches.target: Desktop plugin platform and SDK isolation line.
forbidden_changes: account-sync protocol changes outside plugin platform scope
downstream: desktop-next when plugin platform cycle is READY
long_lived_branches.expected_drift: Expected to drift while plugin platform work is isolated from App RC.
long_lived_branches.drift_criterion: Unexpected only when SDK/shared plugin changes needed by App are parked without an integration plan.

long_lived_branches.name: dev
long_lived_branches.target: macOS App stable mainline and App RC candidate.
forbidden_changes: Web feature work that bypasses D3 when Desktop-impacting
long_lived_branches.expected_drift: dev may have more commits than web because Tauri, native runtime, signing, packaging, and RC work are expected here.
long_lived_branches.drift_criterion: Unexpected only when shared Web/App changes are missing D3 classification or when App-only changes leak back to web without need.

long_lived_branches.name: release/desktop/<version>
long_lived_branches.expected_drift: Short-lived by design; should exist only during a release freeze.
long_lived_branches.drift_criterion: Unexpected if it remains open after release without tag/back-merge status.

short_branch_conventions.target: Desktop plugin, widget, or SDK work
Account cloud-sync and data protocol work
Official website, download, updater, and release-site work
